purpose: Define what HumLit Skills can complete, under which preconditions, and how each claim is smoke-tested.

maturity_levels.stable_offline: Deterministic local capability after locked dependencies are installed.
maturity_levels.conditional_live: Implemented connector whose result depends on network and upstream service availability.
maturity_levels.conditional_desktop: Implemented desktop-browser capability requiring local browser, driver, authorization, and lawful institutional access.
maturity_levels.agent_assisted: Scripts provide auditable evidence or diagnostics; an Agent or researcher must complete interpretation or writing.
maturity_levels.experimental: Opt-in connector with known reliability limits; excluded from default aggregation and fallback.

when_to_use: Search scholarly metadata through OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, arXiv, NSSD, or DBLP.
Use --source api for concurrent aggregation of the five maintained public sources.
when_not_to_use: Do not use for general web search or non-academic content.
Do not claim exhaustive coverage when any source_statuses entry is error.
inputs: Optional year, author, journal, field, page, and sort filters
Optional SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY to reduce anonymous rate limits
output_contract: JSON status/count/results/source_statuses
Every paper title and identifier comes from the live response
Network errors are distinct from empty results
smoke: Live source probes via scripts/smoke_test.py --mode live

when_to_use: Explicitly requested exploratory search of BASE repositories after warning about reliability.
when_not_to_use: Do not include in --source api/all, automatic fallback, or claims of stable source coverage.
output_contract: Same search JSON contract, with BASE source_statuses evidence
smoke: Fixture parser contract only; live reliability is not a release gate

when_to_use: Search Chinese journals, theses, newspapers, or named core-journal systems unavailable from public APIs.
Retrieve CNKI detail pages or downloads when lawful institutional access is already available.
when_not_to_use: Do not run in a pure cloud environment without a visible desktop browser.
Do not imply access when check.capabilities.cnki_feasible is false after an authorized retry.
Do not bypass paywalls, authentication, captchas, or CNKI terms.
inputs: Edge or Chrome and a matching driver
Campus network, institutional VPN, or user-completed CARSI login
A query, CNKI URL, or prior CNKI session
output_contract: JSON result plus explicit actual file format for downloads
Full-text failures degrade to labeled abstract evidence
Partial batch failures retain per-item errors
smoke: CNKI DOM and parser fixtures in tests
Manual desktop canary required for authenticated search/download

when_to_use: Resolve and download a legally open PDF from a DOI through Unpaywall or OpenAlex.
when_not_to_use: Do not promise a PDF for closed-access or missing OA records
Do not treat an HTML landing page as a PDF
output_contract: Verified %PDF file saved atomically
JSON path/bytes/url/method
--link-only returns a link without claiming a downloaded file
smoke: Live DOI link/download probe via scripts/smoke_test.py --mode live

when_to_use: Trace forward or backward citations for a DOI, arXiv ID, or supported paper URL.
when_not_to_use: Do not infer a complete citation graph when Semantic Scholar lacks the paper or rate-limits the request.
inputs: DOI, arXiv ID, or supported paper URL
output_contract: JSON paper/citing/references with upstream identifiers
smoke: Live known-DOI probe via scripts/smoke_test.py --mode live

when_to_use: Inspect a saved research library or compute descriptive year, keyword, citation, and source summaries.
when_not_to_use: Do not interpret descriptive counts as causal trends or field-wide coverage without documenting the search corpus.
inputs: A valid versioned session created by search or import
output_contract: JSON summaries traceable to the stored records
Corrupt sessions stop with a backup path instead of becoming an empty library

when_to_use: Build a traceable evidence scaffold, outline, bounded draft, support check, or topic hypothesis from a saved corpus.
when_not_to_use: Do not present generated text as a publication-ready review
Do not call corpus sparsity a real research gap without broader retrieval and full-text verification
Do not treat lexical overlap as semantic entailment
inputs: Abstract or full-text evidence for claims that go beyond metadata
output_contract: Evidence indices and trace_status
Metadata-only items are labeled for full-text checking
Drafts and topic suggestions state corpus bounds

when_to_use: Import supported bibliographic records and deterministically format/export known metadata.
when_not_to_use: Do not invent missing author, year, pages, edition, DOI, archive number, or source container
Do not claim style compliance for fields absent from the source record
inputs: Supported NoteExpress, Refworks, or BibTeX data, or a valid session
output_contract: JSON or explicitly requested raw text
Missing metadata remains visibly missing
Optional Crossref enrichment is not required for base formatting

when_to_use: Read text/docx, create or patch docx, or extract bibliographic metadata from a local PDF.
when_not_to_use: Do not use read-paper for PDF full text
Do not claim a patch succeeded when targets are reported not_found
Do not use pdf-meta as a substitute for reading the paper
output_contract: JSON artifact paths and operation counts
Original docx is not overwritten by default
pdf-meta returns only observed metadata plus optional Crossref data

when_to_use: Turn supplied school/journal rules into a profile, inspect observable formatting, and apply fixable layout rules.
when_not_to_use: Do not claim unknown/unobservable dimensions passed
Do not invent institution-specific requirements
Do not auto-create missing scholarly content
inputs: User-supplied requirements encoded as a validated profile
output_contract: issues with severity/fixable and observed/unknown dimensions
A new formatted docx
Non-fixable content issues remain explicit

when_to_use: Compute auditable readiness signals and conduct a bounded mock review against a stated rubric.
when_not_to_use: Do not represent the result as an official committee decision
Do not score dimensions whose manuscript evidence was not read
Do not turn integrity flags into misconduct findings
inputs: Agent access to the actual text for qualitative judgments
output_contract: Deterministic signals plus needs_human_judgment
Agent report labels evidence gaps and simulation status

when_to_use: Format user-supplied ancient book, archive, gazetteer, epigraph, periodical, genealogy, or oral-history metadata.
when_not_to_use: Do not infer missing edition, juan, date, archive, fonds, file number, page, or provenance.
inputs: One or more source records with an explicit source_category
output_contract: Deterministic footnote and/or GB/T 7714 text
Per-entry missing-field warnings

when_to_use: Locate deterministic Chinese academic-writing signals before a meaning-preserving rewrite.
when_not_to_use: Do not treat signal counts as prose quality scores
Do not rewrite without checking the author's intended meaning
Do not claim plagiarism or similarity detection
inputs: Chinese markdown, text, docx, or stdin
output_contract: Located warning signals only
Agent performs and explains any rewrite

when_to_use: Check observable length, abstract, keyword, reference, and anonymity rules against a supplied journal profile.
when_not_to_use: Do not infer acceptance probability, journal quality, scope fit, or unobserved editorial rules
Do not delete identity-bearing text without user confirmation
inputs: Target journal instructions encoded as a validated profile
output_contract: Rule issues and located anonymity leaks
Body-only and total word-count scopes remain distinct

when_to_use: Apply an explicit keyword/regex codebook reproducibly and compute paragraph-level co-occurrence.
when_not_to_use: Do not call it semantic open coding, grounded-theory saturation, theme discovery, or causal analysis
inputs: Validated codebook with literal keywords and/or regular expressions
output_contract: Exact matches, locators, frequencies, uncovered paragraphs, and co-occurrence counts

when_to_use: Retrieve a bounded theory catalog and shortlist candidates by explicit keyword overlap.
when_not_to_use: Do not treat overlap score as theoretical fit, originality, explanatory power, or advisor endorsement
Do not imply the built-in catalog is exhaustive
inputs: Optional discipline and schema-valid custom library
output_contract: Candidate theories with matched keywords and catalog provenance
Researcher verifies primary and field-specific literature

when_to_use: Inspect local prerequisites, clean derived cache files, or render/execute documented workflow templates.
when_not_to_use: Do not interpret connector_available as a successful live API probe
Do not execute conditional workflow steps when their prerequisites are unmet
inputs: Workflow variables when executing a template
output_contract: check separates maturity, connector readiness, and runtime verification
workflow stops at the first failed step and preserves prior results
